title: The job board
hints: Optional fields get a `?` after the name. `FeaturedListing` doesn't repeat Listing's fields: `interface FeaturedListing extends Listing { … }`. For the missing-openings default, think about which operator keeps a real `0`.
`openingsLeft` is `listing.openings ?? 1` (`||` would turn 0 into 1). `hire` and `feature` both copy the listing with spread and then set one field after it: `{ ...listing, field: value }`.
function hire(listing: Listing): Listing { return { ...listing, openings: Math.max(0, openingsLeft(listing) - 1) }; }
